title: Wait for the reservation status and format the result
goal: Use async, await and try...catch to read asynchronous results and errors.
summary: The provided queryStatus function returns a Promise. Display the reservation number and available seats on success, or show a message when the request fails.
tasks: completes the async function reservationLabel(code) and waits for queryStatus(code).
On success, return “CODE: Seats left N”, for example “A-6: Seats left 12”. On failure, return “Query failed: ” followed by the error message.

example.note: await obtains the success value, and when the Promise is rejected, it is handed over to catch like an exception.

hint: Await queryStatus before reading the seats property.
